description: This Java class defines AddressSupport, a singleton managing address layout templates within the OpenMRS framework. It handles loading address templates from global properties, serializes/deserializes them, and listens for global property changes related to address layout configurations.

classes.name: AddressSupport
classes.description: Manages address layout templates, implements singleton pattern, listens for global property changes, and provides methods to access and modify address layout templates within the OpenMRS system.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of AddressSupport, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the AddressSupport instance, loads global address template properties, and sets up special tokens.

methods.name: getDefaultLayoutFormat
methods.description: Returns the default layout format code name.

methods.name: setAddressTemplate
methods.description: Sets the address template list and updates the default layout format.

methods.name: getAddressTemplate
methods.description: Retrieves the current address templates, loading from global properties if not initialized.

methods.name: supportsPropertyName
methods.description: Checks if the property name matches the address template global property.

methods.name: globalPropertyChanged
methods.description: Handles updates to the address template global property, updating internal templates accordingly.

methods.name: setAddressTemplate
methods.description: Deserializes XML into an AddressTemplate object and sets it as current template.

methods.name: globalPropertyDeleted
methods.description: Handles deletion of the address template global property, resetting templates.
